blocks.text: GLOSSARY

blocks.label: paragraph_title
blocks.text: C

blocks.label: text
blocks.text:
camerate: distinctive cross-banding found in some chaetae of Orbinidae.
capillary chaeta: slender, often long, chaeta tapering to a fine point.
capillary, capillaries: see capillary chaeta.
caruncle: projection from the posterior end of the prostomium carrying nuchal organs.
cauda: posterior end in Sabellariidae.
cephalic cage: long, forwardly directed chaetae enclosing the head, as in some Flabelligeridae.
cephalic keel: median ridge on the prostomium or head, as in some Maldanidae.
cephalic plaque: plate-like antero-dorsal surface of the head region in some Maldanidae. Also called cephalic plate.
cephalic veil: Smooth or fringed structure surrounding the buccal region in Pectinariidae. Probably comprising the prostomium and peristomium.
cephalization: incorporation or modification of anterior segments to form a head.
ceratophore: basal part of an antenna.
ceratostyle: distal part of an antenna.
chaeta, chaetae: a chitinous bristle protruding from an epidermal pocket in the body wall.
chaetal inversion: presence of uncini on the notopodia, rather than the more usual position on the neuropodia.
chaetiger: segment bearing chaetae.
chaetigerous lobe: that projection or part of the notopodium or neuropodium that bears the chaetae.
chaetoblast: cell that forms, together with follicle cells, a chaeta.
chemoautotroph: organism able to synthesize organic nutrients from inorganic sources, excluding photosynthesis.
chevron: V-shaped chitinized jaw piece at the base of the proboscis in some Goniadidae.
chlorocruorin: respiratory blood pigment; changes in colour from green to red with increasing concentration.
chromatophil gland: densely staining gland in the ventral pinnule of Tomopteris; see also rosette gland.
chromatophore: special cell or group of cells carrying pigment.
ciliophore: distinct area or epidermal patch covered with cilia.
circular muscle: muscle layer encircling the body between the epidermis and longitudinal muscle layer.
circumoesophageal connective: tracts of nervous tissue passing down from the brain on either side of the foregut and connecting to the ventral nerve cord.
cirriform: slender and cylindrical.
cirrophore: basal projection on which a cirrus is mounted.
cirrostyle: distal part of a cirrus.
cirrus, cirri: parapodial appendages; usually slender and cylindrical, can be elongate on anterior segments of some Phyllodocida (see anterior cirri). Also refers to peristomial structures in some Eunicidae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: clade: a common ancestor and all its descendants.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: cladistics: systematics based on discovering synapomorphies to group organisms, in principle, recognizing only clades as taxa.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: clitellum: a thickened glandular area, that secrets a cocoon or egg capsule in Clitellata. The clitellum is located over several segments in the anterior third of the body.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: coelom, coelomate: body cavity often with a peritoneal lining; formed in embryonic mesoderm; characteristic of many bilateral animals.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: coelomoduct: a tubule derived from mesodermal tissue, connecting the coelom with the external environment and may have a coelomostome; said to combine with a nephridium and termed nephromixia or mixonephridia.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: coelomostome: funnel at the inner end of a coelomoduct.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: cold seep: emergence of fluid from sedimentary rocks under pressure, such as in regions of continental subduction; may comprise hydrocarbons, such as methane, or water, bearing salts such as sulphides.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: collar: anterior encircling fold or flap, such as that covering the base of the radiolar crown in Sabellidae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: comb chaeta: simple chaeta with a comb-like arrangement of teeth on the distal end; present in some Eunicida.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: commensalism: an association between two species that live together, which benefits individuals of one species without harming those of the other.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: commissure: a transverse band of neural tissue linking paired ventral nerves or longitudinal nerve tracks; also, one of four main tracts of nervous tissue passing through the brain.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: companion chaetae: small, simple chaetae, accompanying, or alternating with larger chaetae, usually hooks of some kind.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: compound chaeta: chaeta having a terminal portion that articulates with the shaft.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: compressed: flattened in one plane, usually laterally.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: corpora pedunculata: paired dorso-laterally situated mushroom-shaped bodies in the brain of Aphrodithiformia, Nereididae, Hesionoidea, possibly Nephtyidae and Serpulidae.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: crown: a bilaterally symmetrical branched structure in some annelids (Oweniidae, Sabellida) formed by prostomial palps.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: ctenidia: small ciliated pads on the notopodia between the elytophores or dorsal tubercles and the notochaetae, or on the parapodia of some scale-worms.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: ctenognaths: Eunicida in which the jaws comprise relatively large basal maxillae and symmetrically arranged rows of numerous anterior denticles in longitudinal series without carriers.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: cupule, cupules: fused pair or pairs of notopodia in anterior body of some Chaetopteridae, appearing as an elaborate cup-shape.
